newsitem.title: THAILAND: Phatra to float 1.2 bln baht debentures.
newsitem.headline: Phatra to float 1.2 bln baht debentures.

text.p: Phatra Thanakit Plc said on Friday it will float up to 1.2 billion baht of unsecured five-year new debentures through a private placement.
Phatra Thanakit said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand it would work out and announce terms and timing of the debenture issue later.
It said the new issue is part of up to 10 billion baht in debentures that the finance and securities firm decided to float last March.
The company earlier last year had issued 2.5 billion baht of similar debentures under the 10 billion baht fund raising plan.
